summary: Implemented the unknown-total (None) Progress task feature across rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and tests/test_progress.py. Nothing is committed. tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (52 tests). Not verified: black was not available in the shared venv, so formatting was not checked by tool. tests/test_pretty.py fails at collection because the venv lacks the 'attr' module. 13 failures in test_card, test_markdown, test_markdown_no_hyperlinks, test_syntax, and test_traceback look like pygments color differences; those modules do not use progress code, but I did not run them against the untouched snapshot to confirm they pre-date my change. The pulse reference string in the new render test is captured from this implementation with a fixed clock, and was checked for shape only, not against an independent reference.
